brief: A savings app for first-time savers who find finance intimidating. It should feel calm, safe and patient — the opposite of flashy trading apps.
criteria: Success: distinct from blue fintech marks, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, feels calm and safe.

concepts.name: Horizon H
concepts.idea: An H whose crossbar is a calm horizon line.
rationale: Letterform works as app icon and favicon
The horizon expresses calm and patience
Built on a 16-unit grid with one radius

concepts.name: Safe Bay
concepts.idea: A sheltering bay shape that holds a coin in its negative space.
rationale: Negative-space coin rewards a second look

concepts.name: Rising Tide
concepts.idea: Three stacked waves that rise like a growing balance.
rationale: Growth expressed gently, not as a stock chart

recommendation: Horizon H — the most ownable, the strongest at small sizes, and it grows naturally into an icon set.
next_steps: Pick a direction (or tell us what you like in each)
Final artwork, variants and mini guidelines
